title: Chrome Extensions
description: A collection of separate Chrome extension projects (YouTube negative-filter variants, an AI link copy/paste tool, a downloaded chrome-extensions-samples reference repo, and a PH negative filter). (Split into individual repos - see the 5 separate entries below; this combined entry is kept for reference but hidden by default.)
howToUse: Open each subfolder individually; most build with 'npm install && npm run build' then load the resulting 'build' folder unpacked via chrome://extensions.

title: YouTube Negative Filter Extension
description: A Chrome extension that filters/hides content on YouTube (an early, simpler variant of the yt-negative-filter-es6 extensions).
howToUse: npm install && npm run build (if applicable), then load unpacked via chrome://extensions, selecting this folder.
